blurb.text: A country with a 5,000-year winemaking history, one of the oldest wine production regions in the world. Its most planted grapes are Cabernet Sauvignon and Chardonnay, then Merlot, Sauvignon Blanc and Syrah. Its areas include the Bekaa Valley, Batroun, Mount Lebanon, North Lebanon and Jezzine.
